legend.freewayTdcsSim.loadError: Failed to load data (freeway simulation files not found)
legend.freewayTdcsSim.dataWindow: Data covers only 2026-09-28 (last day of the Teachers' Day long weekend), 16:00–18:00
legend.freewayTdcsSim.outsideWindow: The current time is outside the data window, so no vehicles are drawn
legend.freewayTdcsSim.active: {n} vehicles on the road at this moment
legend.freewayTdcsSim.trailNote: Trails show the past N seconds of travel (set N and line width in layer settings). Click a vehicle to see its entry and exit interchanges and follow it (Esc to stop).
legend.freewayTdcsSim.nearNote: From z15 vehicles are drawn as 3D boxes sized by type and facing their direction of travel. With a tilted map and 3D terrain, vehicles follow the terrain, viaducts use the data's road elevation, and vehicles in tunnels are hidden by the mountain; on a flat map vehicles inside tunnels are not drawn.
legend.freewayTdcsSim.source: Source: Freeway Bureau, MOTC, Traffic Database (TDCS M06A, 2026-09-28); positions between gantries and lanes are estimated
legend.freewayTdcsSim.followEnd.window: Time left the data window; stopped following
legend.freewayTdcsSim.followEnd.before: This is before the vehicle entered the freeway; stopped following
legend.freewayTdcsSim.followEnd.service: The vehicle entered a service area (long stop); stopped following
legend.freewayTdcsSim.followEnd.exited: The vehicle has left the freeway; stopped following
